sn55.23:3.5: That Blessed One is … teacher of gods and humans, awakened, blessed.
sn55.23:5.1: “Sir, I went up to Godhā the Sakyan and said:
sn55.23:5.2: ‘Godhā, how many things must an individual have for you to recognize them as a stream-enterer, not liable to be reborn in the underworld, assured, destined for awakening?’
sn55.23:5.3: When I had spoken, sir, Godhā the Sakyan said to me—
sn55.23:6.1: Mahānāma, an individual must have three things for me to recognize them as a stream-enterer.
sn55.23:6.3: It’s when a noble disciple has experiential confidence in the Buddha—
sn55.23:6.4: That Blessed One is … teacher of gods and humans, awakened, blessed.
sn55.23:6.6: and they have experiential confidence in the Saṅgha—
sn55.23:6.7: The Saṅgha of the Buddha’s disciples is practicing the way that’s good … It is the supreme field of merit for the world.
sn55.23:6.8: When an individual has these three things I recognize them as a stream-enterer.
sn55.23:6.9: But Mahānāma, what things must an individual have for you to recognize them as a stream-enterer?’
sn55.23:7.1: Addressed like this, sir, I said to Godhā the Sakyan:
sn55.23:7.2: ‘Godhā, an individual must have four things for me to recognize them as a stream-enterer.
sn55.23:7.4: It’s when a noble disciple has experiential confidence in the Buddha—
sn55.23:7.5: That Blessed One is … teacher of gods and humans, awakened, blessed.
sn55.23:7.8: And they have the ethical conduct loved by the noble ones … leading to immersion.
sn55.23:7.9: When an individual has these four things I recognize them as a stream-enterer.’
sn55.23:8.1: When I had spoken, sir, Godhā the Sakyan said to me:
sn55.23:8.3: Only the Buddha would know whether or not they have these things.’
sn55.23:8.9: May the Buddha remember me as having such confidence.
sn55.23:8.12: May the Buddha remember me as having such confidence.
sn55.23:8.15: May the Buddha remember me as having such confidence.
